title: Scaling an expectation
statement: Let $Omega$ be a finite set, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $Omega$, let $c\in\bbr$, and let $f:Omega\to br$. The expectation of $x\mapsto c f(x)$ equals $c$ times the expectation of $f$.
